title: Ascendant vs Descendant
caption:
ascendant vs descendant: what's the difference? 🌙
One is how you show up. The other is what you look for in a partner.
cta:
send this to someone who only knows their sun sign 👀
your full chart is free on align, link in bio

ask: Ten seconds, and you'll read your chart better.
explainA: Your *ascendant* was rising in the east
explainB: Your *descendant* was setting in the west,
diff: The other is what you look for in a *partner.*
